expectedValue.description:
When the config value stored at the configPath location is equal to this expected value,
the condition will be truthy.

configPath.description:
The path for the configuration from UiSdlConfig.
Example: If you define the "myApp" field in {@link UiSdlApplicationConfig} and it contains a field called "myFeature",
you need to provide ["myApp", "myFeature"] here.
